tools.name: summarize-openapi-specs
tools.description: Get a summary of available OpenAPI and AsyncAPI descriptions, including info, servers, HTTP paths or message channel names.

tools.name: search-openapi-operations
tools.description: Search the available OpenAPI and AsyncAPI descriptions for HTTP operations or message channels related to a user's query. Return matching content, including referenced message payloads. AsyncAPI channels are documentation only and cannot be executed as HTTP requests.

tools.name: search-documentation
tools.description: Search the available documentation for pages related to a user's query and return a list of related content matching the search criteria.

tools.name: execute-request
tools.description: Execute an HTTP request for a specific scalar document and operation.

serverBaseUrl.description: Must be one of the document's declared server URLs. Requests to any other host are rejected.
